description: A drop of R-3 plus an addition r1 that removes the Workflow heading B-6, backed by D-3, is accepted with no events: the remove arrives as a new recommendation, not as a revision of an add.
section: IMPL §3.3.6 (REGEN-002: a different operation is a drop plus an addition), §3.3.5 steps 2 and 4, §3.8 (a remove of a heading, accepted as one recommendation for its whole section)

actions.reason: The decision it relied on was superseded.
Replaced by removing the Workflow section.
The change does not touch it.

additions.rationale: The developer decided the Workflow section no longer matches how the team works.
